g.text: SD09 — Reach Ending (UC13, F12; Template Method)
body of GameController.endGame(), referenced by SD02 and SD04
(n1) Called from SD02 when isGameOver() is true: the main quest completed, or the player's HP reached 0 (SD04).
(n2) sum of getAlignmentDelta() over all events: +2 per side quest completed for an NPC, −1 per failed quest, −2 per item
(n3) DEATH if the player died; otherwise HEROIC (score ≥ 3), DARK (score ≤ −3) or NEUTRAL
(prompt includes the fixed facts from story memory;
isValid: mentions only recorded events and fits the ending type;
fallback: template epilogue for the ending type)
